newsitem.title: CHINA: Storm pounds southwest China, 39 feared dead.
newsitem.headline: Storm pounds southwest China, 39 feared dead.

text.p: Wind, rain and hail pounded China's southwestern Yunnan province last week, and 39 people are feared dead, the Yunnan Daily said in an edition seen in Beijing on Monday.
The number of people killed or missing totalled 39 by May 7, the newspaper said. Eighty-five people were injured.
The storm dumped 120 mm of rain in Yunnan's Da'guan county, triggering floods and mudslides, the newspaper said.
Hailstones with a diameter of six cm (2.4 inches) battered the county, destroying crops, it said.
About 200 houses in Huang'ge town collapsed, sections of two bridges were washed away, electricity and tap water were cut off and roads damaged, it said without giving further details.
Officials could not be reached for comment.
